about.title: About Me
about.description: Get to know the person behind the pixels. Currently learning the 'how' so I can build the 'why'.
about.bio1: I'm a third-year Informatics student at University of Tartu. My interest in Data Science and Software Development was sparked by the Generative AI explosion in 2022. Since then, I have been experimenting with how these technologies work under the hood.
about.bio2: I enjoy building personal projects to learn new tools. Recently, I developed an interactive voice-agent using Python, and an LLM-powered chess bot using Vue.js. I often leverage AI tools to accelerate my own coding and learning process.
about.bio3: Besides IT studies, I enjoy working out, reading, and self-development. I'm active in the academic organization EÜS Põhjala where I'm currently serving as House Elder. I am currently looking for an internship in Data Science or AI Engineering to learn from experienced developers and tackle real-world problems.

hobbies.description1: As a developer, I believe in systematic thinking beyond just work. I enjoy consciously designing my life—whether through setting long-term goals (like 5-year plans) or optimizing daily habits to ensure stability and clarity.
hobbies.description2: A significant part of my free time is dedicated to audiobooks and self-improvement. I balance intense mental work with physical activity: I enjoy long bike rides in the summer, and year-round gym sessions or long walks to clear my mind. Recently, I took on a new creative challenge and started learning the piano.
hobbies.description3: I am social by nature and highly value quality time with my family. I am also an active member of the Student Society EÜS Põhjala, where I have served as Archivist and currently hold the responsibilities of the House Elder.

chess.title: ♟ Chess Tip:
tips: Control the center (e4, d4, e5, d5) - it's the key to chess dominance!
Develop your knights and bishops early - don't move the same piece twice in the opening!
Castle your king to safety - usually within the first 10 moves!
Think before you move: 'When you see a good move, look for a better one!' - Emanuel Lasker
Protect your queen but don't bring her out too early in the game!
Forks are powerful - knights are especially good at creating forks!
Always check your opponent's threats before making your move!
Endgame tip: Activate your king - it's a strong piece in the endgame!
